item.projectminecraft.solemn_lament.flav: The Living and The Departed. A funeral for the butterflies.
item.projectminecraft.solemn_lament.abil: Use: five coins, five shots from two pistols at random enemies, each a swarm of butterflies
Heads add power. Hits heal you and sink their speed. Then the funeral
item.projectminecraft.magic_bullet.flavo: Seven bullets. The seventh is never yours.
item.projectminecraft.magic_bullet.abili: Use: one coin, one bullet through a corridor of magic circles, piercing everything and setting it ablaze
Counts from 1 to 7. The seventh bullet is something else
item.projectminecraft.fourth_match_flame: One match is enough to burn the world.
Use: one coin. Appear before the enemy and write 'fierce' in fire
item.projectminecraft.black_silence.abil: Wear them (Curios hands slot, or the offhand). With an empty hand, attacks use the workshop weapon: tap B for the next one, hold B for the wheel
Strike one enemy with all twelve weapons, then unleash Furioso from the centre of the wheel. Random mode draws a new weapon every few hits
item.projectminecraft.black_silence.no_t: No one in front of you to beat down
key.projectminecraft.black_silence: Weapon / spell wheel (tap: next, hold: wheel)
item.projectminecraft.library_invitation: A black card edged in gold. Someone is expecting you.
Hold up to be taken to the Library (and home again)
item.projectminecraft.black_silence_mask: Worn over the face, hostile creatures don't notice you, not even an enderman meeting your eyes. Strike one and that one sees you.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.title: The Black Silence
projectminecraft.boss.angelica.title: Angelica
projectminecraft.boss.roland.phase.5: The Black Silence: Images of the Bygones
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.0: A guest. Fine. Let's get this over with.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.1: I'll be gentle. That's a lie.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.2: Ah... it's coming back up. All of it.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.4: I remember every one of them. Every single guest.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.5: They're still here. All of them.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.7: Go on, then. Leave me too.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.8: That's what really scares me, Angelica.
projectminecraft.boss.roland.line.10: Come back when you've got the nerve to be a book.
message.projectminecraft.library.arrive: The Library. A reception is waiting for you.
message.projectminecraft.library.won: The reception is over. The pages take you home...
message.projectminecraft.library.reward: Something from the reception came home with you.
message.projectminecraft.library.lost: You lost the reception, but kept your belongings. The invitation still stands.
message.projectminecraft.roland.dark_mar: Dark Mark: his blows land harder
projectminecraft.boss.claw.title: Executioner of the Head
projectminecraft.boss.claw.line.0: Keep perfectly still, or you'll be torn apart.
projectminecraft.boss.claw.line.1: Remember. Even you of all cityfolk can be ripped to shreds in your current state.
projectminecraft.boss.claw.line.3: The book is not here. Withdrawing.
item.projectminecraft.black_silence_book: What was left of the reception. The Head would want it.
item.projectminecraft.claw_mask.desc: Wood and rust, no face behind it. A trophy.
item.projectminecraft.broken_claw.desc: The Claw's prosthetic, snapped. Fix it with netherite scrap and iron.
item.projectminecraft.broken_serum_k.des: A cracked green vial. A glass bottle and a golden apple would mend it.
item.projectminecraft.broken_serum_r.des: A cracked orange vial. A glass bottle and blaze powder would mend it.
item.projectminecraft.broken_serum_w.des: A cracked blue vial. A glass bottle and an ender pearl would mend it.
item.projectminecraft.claw_arm.desc: Mended. It still needs its three serums.
item.projectminecraft.serum_r.desc: R Corp: strength, for a while.
item.projectminecraft.serum_w.desc: W Corp: the space between two places.
item.projectminecraft.handmade_claw.desc: The three serums run straight into your hand.
item.projectminecraft.handmade_claw.k: K: a green aura, your hits heal you
item.projectminecraft.handmade_claw.r: R: a red aura, stronger, tougher, faster, hits burn
item.projectminecraft.handmade_claw.w: W: blink through enemies, the next hit is a big slash
item.projectminecraft.handmade_claw.tri: Tri-serum: all three, stronger; right-click a target to drag it through the dimensions
